ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a schematic diagram of the distribution of major petrochemical enterprises in China, and the legend uses different dot symbols to represent large, medium-sized, and Chinese-foreign joint venture petrochemical enterprises. These dot symbols in the figure are not evenly scattered, but are relatively concentrated in the eastern coastal areas, the Yangtze River basin, and some urban agglomeration areas, presenting the phenomenon that petrochemical enterprises are clustered and distributed in several regions. Combined with the question stem "after the establishment of a petrochemical industrial park," park-based development is equivalent to further strengthening concentrated layout on the basis of the original enterprise clustering. After industrial clustering, enterprises can share infrastructure such as roads, pipe networks, ports, and environmental protection, and shorten the transportation distance of raw materials, products, and cooperation links between enterprises, thereby reducing transportation expenses and cooperation costs. Therefore, after the establishment of a petrochemical industrial park, enterprise costs will be reduced.

method.method_draft: 先描述图中石化企业点状符号在若干区域集中分布的现象，再结合题干“石化工业园区建立后”判断园区化就是进一步强化这种集聚。根据工业集聚可共享基础设施、减少运输和协作成本的规则，推出对企业成本的影响是降低成本。
